text:
Happy Sunday! We're starting right around freezing, so expect some frost on the windshield, but plenty of sunshine takes over and the afternoon is a beauty, with a high near 61. A few high clouds slide in later ahead of a cold front, and a light south breeze picks up. It's a great day for a walk to catch the last of the fall color. Tonight won't be nearly as cold, with a low around 40.

Monday stays mild, near 60 in the NWS forecast, though some of the models run a few degrees cooler, with more clouds around. A shower or sprinkle is possible between 3 and 4 in the afternoon, but the air ahead of the front is so dry that I wouldn't bother with an umbrella. Then the switch flips. Tuesday only climbs into the 40s, with lows in the 20s, and Wednesday morning could be the coldest we've seen yet, in the lower teens to lower 20s, maybe flirting with a record. Enjoy a light jacket today, and dig out the heavy coat before Tuesday.
